changes.support: Unlike the federal rule and most states, Saturday does not count in Michigan.
A written agreement or offer to purchase and the notice of cancellation attached to the agreement or offer shall be written in the same language as that used in any oral presentation

changes.new: Business day is Monday through Friday; Saturday, Sunday and ten named holidays do not count (445.111(c)).
changes.support: "Business day" (445.111(c)) "means Monday through Friday and does not include Saturday, Sunday, or" ten named holidays.

changes.new: No statute found requiring a written contract at a set amount; a written contract is needed for a contractor to have a residential construction lien (570.1114)

changes.new: Residential builder or maintenance and alteration license (crafts include pools, tile, concrete, masonry); a license is needed at $600.00 and up, exempt only under $600.00 (339.2403(f))
changes.support: So a license is needed at $600.00 and up, not "over $600".

unsure: MI-lien: the 570.1114 statement lists required content and also names electricians, plumbers and mechanical contractors, so it is not clear a general contractor's contract needs every part; no sentence is prescribed so nothing is loaded.
MI-cancel: 445.113 applies only to a home solicitation sale of more than $25 solicited at the buyer's residence; the builder only knows 'sold at the customer's home', so the trigger is approximate.
Home Improvement Finance Act cancellation: the file says it was not located, so nothing was changed for it.
